harness: proof.mjs in this folder holds every script of the run as text (node proof.mjs <folder> writes them out); built on the SCRUM-944 harness: one headless Chromium, the inbox Simulator, Book Date, Create BEO, the review, Approve, the app's and the till's own routes
rules: ZZ TEST simulator threads from invented numbers never used before (6689909581x; the husband number 089 870 0417 is invented), ZZ TEST events and one ZZ TEST till of this run only; no sale, no payment, no print; the till's Settle party preview only (writes nothing); no direct database write; names held in memory only and masked; every picture opened before it was kept
memory: the laptop fell below 3 GB free three times (to 0.07 GB once; the largest user was not this proof); every long step waited for 3 GB, so thread G's second read and thread H waited about an hour in all
modelReadsPressed: Create BEO 9 times (A, B, D, G twice, H, I twice, O) and Fetch from chat once (A); Book Date read each of the 7 threads; the inbox assistant answered each opener as staging does

lines.text: Hi! We'd like to book a birthday party for our daughter ZZ Test Lina, she turns 6. Saturday 5 December, from 14:00 to 16:30, 12 kids and 8 adults. (ZZ TEST)
We'd like the Floresta birthday package. Hawaiian pizza for the kids, no pineapple on half. And chicken fried rice for the adults. (ZZ TEST)
Could we have the bubble show at 15:00? And 2 of the park's cakes at 800 baht each, at 16:00 please. For decoration a jungle theme with green and gold balloons. (ZZ TEST)

Important: she is allergic to peanuts. For the setup, balloons at the entrance by 13:30 please. If you can't reach me, please call my husband on 089 870 0417. We will transfer the 3,000 baht deposit tomorrow. (ZZ TEST)
Hello, a birthday party for ZZ Test Mika turning 7 on Sunday 13 December, 10:00 to 12:00, 10 kids and 6 adults. (ZZ TEST)
The Floresta birthday package please, and fried rice for the adults please. I already transferred the 3,000 deposit. (ZZ TEST)
Hi, a party for ZZ Test Sami turning 8, Sunday 20 December 15:00-17:30, 14 kids and 10 adults. (ZZ TEST)

The Floresta birthday package. For the kids' set menu the Margherita pizza please. On top of that, 2 more Margherita pizzas for the kids on the side at 450 each, and 3 more Margherita pizzas for the adults. (ZZ TEST)
Торт мы принесём свой, в 17:00. (ZZ TEST)
Hi, a party for ZZ Test Remy turning 6, Saturday 12 December 11:00-13:00, 12 kids and 8 adults. (ZZ TEST)
The Floresta birthday package with the Margherita pizza for the kids. The adults will eat the same as the kids, the Margherita pizza for them too. (ZZ TEST)
Hello, a birthday party for ZZ Test Kai turning 7 on Saturday 26 December, 10:00 to 12:00, 10 kids and 6 adults. (ZZ TEST)

The Floresta birthday package, the Margherita pizza for the kids with French fries please. On top of that one Pepperoni pizza and a Caesar salad for the adults, two fresh orange juices and a latte. And a durian pizza if you have one. (ZZ TEST)
Hi, a party for ZZ Test Noa turning 5, Sunday 27 December 14:00-16:00, 10 kids and 5 adults. (ZZ TEST)

The Floresta birthday package, Hawaiian pizza for the kids. For the adults a Pepperoni pizza at 300 please, and 2 Margherita pizzas for 900. And 3 extra portions of French fries for the kids. (ZZ TEST)
Hi! We'd like to book a birthday party for our daughter ZZ Test Oona, she is turning 6. Saturday 5 December, from 14:00 to 16:30, 12 kids and 8 adults. (ZZ TEST)

We'd like the Birthday package, Central Floresta with a Hawaiian pizza and a durian pizza for the kids, and the Bubble show. For decoration a dinosaur theme with green balloons please. One of the kids is allergic to peanuts. (ZZ TEST)
For the cake we'd like the park's chocolate cake at 16:00. We already transferred the 3,000 baht deposit this morning. (ZZ TEST)
